mcp.addFile.message: Adds {file} to the workspace (.hive/mcp){files, plural, =0 {} one {, with its file in a folder of its own} other {, with its # files in a folder of its own}}, turned off. Turn it on in the MCP view to choose the projects it runs in. It runs:
mcp.addFile.replaceDetail: Replace moves it (and the folder of one added from a .zip) to the Recycle Bin and adds this one, turned off: projects that had the old one on lose it. Or choose another name.
mcp.allProjects.confirmMessage: New sessions in every project start it, except in projects that turned it off in their MCP tab. To use it in one project only, turn it on in that project's MCP tab instead. It runs:
mcp.enable.confirmMessage: New sessions in the projects you tick start it. It runs:
mcp.enable.noProjects: The workspace has no projects yet: turn it on in a project's MCP tab once there is one.
mcp.enable.projectsLabel: Projects to turn it on in
mcp.error.fileChanged: {file} has changed since it was shown to you. Add it again to see what it runs.
mcp.error.noServer: The workspace has no MCP server named {name}.
mcp.import.changed: {count, plural, one {{names} changed in the project's config after you saw it, so it was copied turned off: check what it runs and turn it on with its switch in the MCP view.} other {{names} changed in the project's config after you saw them, so they were copied turned off: check what they run and turn them on with their switches in the MCP view.}}
mcp.import.confirmMessage: {count, plural, one {It is turned on in {project} straight away; other projects can turn it on in their MCP tab. It runs:} other {They are turned on in {project} straight away; other projects can turn them on in their MCP tab. They run:}}
mcp.import.confirmTitle: {count, plural, one {Copy {name} to the workspace?} other {Copy # MCP servers to the workspace?}}
mcp.list.allOffTip: Off in the workspace: it runs nowhere. Click to turn it on and choose the projects it runs in.
mcp.list.allOnTip: On in the workspace: it runs in the projects that have it on (new sessions). Click to turn it off everywhere; the projects keep their choices for when it is on again.
mcp.project.confirmMessage: New sessions in {project} start it. It runs:
mcp.tab.hint: Every MCP server in the workspace is available here: turn on the ones this project's agents need. A server runs here only while it is on in the workspace too (its switch in the MCP view).
mcp.tab.projectDefined: These servers are in the project's own agent config (such as .mcp.json). Hive starts sessions with only workspace servers, so they stay disabled until copied to the workspace, which turns them on here.
